operators.name: replace_inf_with_nan
semantics: Equivalent to torch.where(torch.isinf(x), torch.tensor(float('nan'), device=x.device), x).
For each element, if x is +inf or -inf, replace with NaN; otherwise keep original value.
Preserves input dtype (float32), shape, device and memory layout.

operators.name: group_norm_forward
semantics: Equivalent to nn.GroupNorm(num_groups=3, num_channels=3, eps=1e-5, affine=True).forward(x).
Normalization groups: since C == num_groups == 3, each group contains exactly one channel, so normalization is computed per spatial location (N, group, HxW) independently.
For each group: compute mean and variance over all elements in (C/num_groups, H, W) = (1, 256, 256) for each sample, normalize using eps, then apply per-channel affine transform with weight and bias.
Order of operations matches reference: normalize then y = weight[c] * x_norm + bias[c].
Output preserves shape, dtype, device and layout.
Replace all +/-inf values in x with NaN, keep finite values unchanged.
Input x is float32 on cuda:0, shape [512, 3, 256, 256], contiguous.
Output shape and dtype same as input.
Uses torch.where with condition torch.isinf(x), NaN scalar tensor on same device, and original x.
Call self.group_norm (nn.GroupNorm affine=True) on the result of step_001.
Each group consists of one channel; mean and variance computed over the spatial dimensions (256x256) for each sample and group.
Apply affine: y = weight[channel] * (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps) + bias[channel].
Output has same shape and dtype as input.
Return the final group_norm output tensor, shape [512, 3, 256, 256], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
